Query it to learn which model names are valid as the optional third argument to rerank_score(query, document, model) and to confirm licensing before adopting a model. rows.vgi.doc_md:
# supported_models

A discovery table of every cross-encoder reranker the worker can run -- one row per model. Backed by the `supported_models()` table function, it is queried without parentheses -- project the `model` and `license` columns and order by `model`; see the examples below for ready-to-run SQL.

## Columns

| column | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `model` | VARCHAR | Name to pass as the optional third argument to `rerank_score(query, document, model)` (primary key). |
| `license` | VARCHAR | SPDX-style license of the model weights. |

## Notes

Every advertised model is permissive / commercially usable. Reading this table loads no model, so it is always cheap.
